title: Precondition preservation for the scan machine
statement: For any scan task $\tau$, let $x$ be a valid input for that task, and let $a$ be any configuration of the scan machine. Then the machine's precondition holds at $a$: whenever the configuration has a current label, a register-equality instruction compares distinct registers, input-comparison instructions are used only on inputs with the required plain or paired encoding, and calls use a list of distinct registers.
